title: Hablado, Comido, Vivido --- The Participle
label: ch:participle
canDo: I can form the participle of any regular verb, and know it never changes for person.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C49-participio: form the three participles and say whether the form changes with the speaker.
payoff.note: One new ending and one the reader can predict: -er and -ir merge here for the same reason they merged in the preterite.
